query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Reconcile an organization's QuickBooks bank-account ledger by querying existing transactions, removing or undoing incorrect entries, posting corrected ledger activity, creating adjustment entries, recording a customer payment, and verifying financial reports.
query_ground_truth.query: fetch the financial statements to verify if everything reconciles correctly
query_ground_truth.rationale: Verifying financial reports requires retrieving generated account reports to ensure the ledger matches up correctly.

BREX_GET_ACCOUNT_STATEMENTS.description: Get finalized statements for the primary cash account. Returns statement history including start and end balances for each statement period.

limit.description: Maximum number of statements to return. Valid range: 1-1000.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned from a previous request. Leave empty for the first page.

RAMP_LIST_STATEMENTS.description: Tool for listing all statements with filtering options. Perfect for financial reporting and reconciliation workflows.

start.description: ID of the last entity of the previous page for pagination

to_date.description: Filter statements with end_date on or before this date (ISO 8601 datetime). Defaults to current time

from_date.description: Filter statements with end_date on or after this date (ISO 8601 datetime)

page_size.description: Number of results per page (2-100, default: 20)

BREX_GET_COMPANY_CASH_ACCOUNTS.description: Retrieve all cash (deposit) accounts for the company. Returns account details including balances, account numbers, routing numbers, and status. Use this to view available cash accounts, check balances, or get account information for transfers. Each Brex account has at least one primary cash account. Requires the 'accounts.cash.readonly' scope.

limit.description: Maximum number of cash accounts to return per page. Must be between 1 and 1000.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Pass the next_cursor value from a previous response to get the next page of results. Leave empty for the first page.

RAMP_GET_STATEMENT.description: Tool for retrieving statement details or downloading statements. Supports JSON, PDF, and CSV formats...
